name: Alexander
lore:
Son of Philip II of Macedon, Alexander extended his father's
empire across most of the known world and spread Greek culture
far beyond its humble origins.

name: Angry Ram
lore:
"With a screech that quailed our souls, the
ram leapt forward. It ate many of my men, and
we were forced to withdraw for a time."@
-from The Lost E-mails of Odysseus

name: Banshee
lore:
Many tourists avoid Banshees on account of
their heart-blanching screech. But for those
who can endure the soul-chilling horror of
the scream, Banshees are a must-see!@
-A Visitor's Guide to the Underworld

name: Cernian Hind
lore:
Missing: One golden horned, bronze-hooved
deer. Likes to outrun arrows. If found, 
please return to Artemis c/o The Gods,
Mt. Olympus. Reward $$$

name: Chimera
lore:
The original Chimera died long ago at the
hands of the hero Bellerophon, though lesser
Chimerae still prowl the Labyrinth of Crete.@
-Pliny the Absent's Naturalis Historia

name: Cyclops Herder
lore:
Though brutish and stupid, the Cyclops Herder
has a wonderfully beautiful singing voice and
an innate sense of rhythm.@
-from Homer's Book o' Beasties

name: Cyclops Warrior
lore:
Lonely nights, me turn eye to heavens,@
Search stars for answers, find none,@
Eat goats to feel better.@
-Cyclops Poetry Competition runner-up

name: Deino
lore:
"It takes work, but if you can get someone
to really dread you, you know you've done a
good job as a monster."

name: Dryad
lore:
"I love trees. I mean like wow, man, trees. 
They're so chill and relaxed, just grooving
to their thing all day."

name: Enchanted Eagle
lore:
"The second of the sailors I made into a
soaring eagle. I'd lost a discus on the roof
earlier in the day and I thought, 'Hey, I bet
an eagle could get that.'"@
-from Circe's private diary

name: Enchanted Hound
lore:
"The first of the sailors, I transformed into a
hound. I don't know why, exactly. He just
seemed kinda doggy to me."@
-from Circe's private diary

name: Enchanted Lion
lore:
"The third of the sailors, I changed into a
fierce and proud lion. I've always been kind
of a cat person, and it just felt right."@
-from Circe's private diary

name: Enchanted Ram
lore:
"The fourth sailor I remade in the shape
of a ram, mostly because Poseidon bet me
twenty bucks I couldn't."@
-from Circe's private diary

name: Enchanted Scorpion
lore:
"The fifth sailor, I went one way and the other
for a while until wham--'Scorpion!'--it just
hit me."@
-from Circe's private diary

name: Enchanted Serpent
lore:
"The last sailor I made into a serpent. No 
reason at all, just totally spontaneous."@
-from Circe's private diary

name: Enyo
lore:
"For me, nothing beats really horrifying
somebody. The look on their face is always
worth it."

name: Erymanthian Boar
lore:
Goddess seeking monster boar or pig for laying
waste to farmers' fields, general destruction.
Must be in good shape. Bad temper and enormous
tusks a plus.

name: Greater Basilisk
lore:
"My mother was a rooster and my father was
a viper. Is it any wonder I'm such a mess?"

name: Griffon
lore:
Combining the strength of the eagle and the
nobility of the lion, the Griffon is one of the
most majestic creatures known to man. A single
sighting can make the career of a natural
historian, assuming he survives the encounter.@
-Pliny the Absent's Naturalis Historia

name: Harpy
lore:
Popular accounts describe the Harpy as a
horrific stinking bird-woman. A more
even-
handed depiction takes note of its
beautiful plumage and carefully tended claws.@
-Pliny the Absent's Naturalis Historia

name: Harpy Witch
lore:
The Harpy Witch is a rare variant of the 
common Harpy. It is said that it practices
a dark magic known only to itself.@
-Pliny the Absent's Naturalis Historia

name: Kraken
lore:
Though tiny in larval form, Krakens can grow to
the size of a small island. Fishermen often seek
out Kraken-infested waters, drawn by the plentiful
fish who feed on the enormous beast's waste.

name: Manes
lore:
Many fallen heroes inhabit the Netherworld
as Manes, or disembodied spirits. For a small
fee they will regale curious travellers
with fascinating tales of their former lives.@
-A Visitor's Guide to the Underworld

name: Manticore
lore:
The Manticore is a swift and terrible predator
with a keen fondness for human flesh. Oddly,
its voice resembles the union of the sound of
the flute and the trumpet.@
-Pliny the Absent's Naturalis Historia

name: Naiad
lore:
"What could be better than water? So cool, 
so refreshing, so wet. I just can't imagine 
life without it."

name: Orthrus
lore:
Orthrus, two-headed spawn of Echidne and
Typhon, has a bit of a temper, and should
only be viewed from a safe distance.@
-A Visitor's Guide to the Underworld

name: Pemphredo
lore:
"As a Graeae Sister, I like to alarm people,
give them a good startle, really wake them up."

name: Phantom
lore:
The musical obsession of the Phantom is one
of the Netherworld's biggest attractions.
Don't miss out on his special performance!@
-A Visitor's Guide to the Underworld

name: Satyr
lore:
"There's nothing more satisfying than good food
and drink. Clip my hooves, shave my fur, I'm
happy as long as I've got snacks."

name: Scylla
lore:
Once a beautiful nymph, Scylla was transformed
into a horrendous monster by the sorceress
Circe in the grip of a jealous rage.

name: Sea Elemental
lore:
Sea elementals are magical beings, immortal
yet soulless. Their origins are deeply mysterious,
possibly created eons ago by a mad sorcerer.

name: Sea Serpent
lore:
Sea serpents range in size from man-height to 
gigantic. They have plagued the shipping lanes
for thousands of years, devouring boats whole
and leaving little trace of their hapless victims.

name: Sea Witch
lore:
Dark and disturbed worshippers of the sea-god
Poseidon, Sea Witches should be avoided
whenever possible. They harbor a deep 
resentment towards land-based creatures and
will not hesitate to conjure storms against them.

name: Shade
lore:
Start your trip to the Netherworld right
with a quick chat with a Shade. These feisty
spirits have lots of great stories to tell!@
-A Visitor's Guide to the Underworld

name: Siren
lore:
Cursed by the God Demeter for failing to 
intervene when her daughter was kidnapped,
sirens are well known for their irresistibly 
alluring singing. Many sailors have leapt to
their deaths in pursuit of the sirens' song.

name: Specter
lore:
Don't be put off by the Specter's bizarre
appearance and head-@
throwing antics. Attacking
you is his way of saying, "Welcome!"@
-A Visitor's Guide to the Underworld

name: Trojan Captain
lore:
The Trojan army is known for its discipline under
the stress of battle. Observers credit this to the Trojan officer
corps, whose courage and dedication inspires unquestioned loyalty from their men.

name: Trojan Spearman
lore:
Through careful diet and intense training,
Trojan Spearmen make up the backbone of Troy's
defensive forces.

name: Trojan Warrior
lore:
With their powerful weapons forged from
the surest bronze, Trojan warriors are
feared throughout the Greek archipelago.

name: War Hound
lore:
Bred for their size, strength and pure
ferocity, the War Hounds of Troy have tipped
the balance in many battles. Many lesser armies have chosen
to lay down their weapons in surrender rather than face them.

name: Afreet
lore:
Even when bound, Afreets will
seek to destroy their masters.

name: Air Spirit
lore:
Few mortals can stand against
the angry wind of an Air Spirit.

name: Bandit
lore:
He was a bandit, as many were
at that time in that place. He
was different only in that he
smelled bad, very bad...

name: Bilge Dog
lore:
Though a talented dog, Bilgey
soon fell in with bad men and
found himself trapped in a 
world of crime...

name: Bull Elephant
lore:
Some speak of "bull elephants,"
but they are not believed...

name: Cannoneer
lore:
"Ho!" said Perry, rubbing his
belly. "I feel some pirating
coming on! Arrr!"

name: Cutthroat
lore:
There was at that time a thin
and evil man, a cutthroat by
trade, who made it his business
to waylay and threaten all who
came across his path...

name: Deckswabber
lore:
"Another battle?" thought Fred
with a frustrated sigh. "I really
wish they'd just let me do what
I was trained for..."

name: Djinn
lore:
Arrogant spirits that came before
man, Djinns have many powers.

name: Elementalist
lore:
Control of the elements is a
powerful type of magic.

name: Elephant
lore:
A fabulous beast of myth, the
elephant is said to have legs
like tree-trunks and a nose
like a coiling serpent...

name: Embalmed Guardian
lore:
Flynn was not eager to become a
mummy, but he was assured the 
benefits were considerable so
he agreed to the procedure...

name: Enormous Serpent
lore:
Legend has it that there is a
mysterious island where snakes 
sometimes grow to five, perhaps 
seven percent larger than the
usual size...

name: Fire Spirit
lore:
Born of the flames of creation,
Fire Spirits resent the living.

name: Firebreather
lore:
Though rotund in girth and foul
of temper, none could deny the 
might of his prodigious gut...

name: Flying Armor
lore:
New Flying Armor! Soar above the
clouds with this handsome item!
Disclaimer: This armor does not
allow owner to fly.

name: Flying Pig
lore:
Sure, anybody can own a regular
pig, but for a mere fifty gold
pieces this astonishing FLYING
pig can be yours! Limited offer!

name: Flying Snake
lore:
Flying Snake, only two copper 
pieces. Goes great with any
outfit. Only bites a little.

name: Flying Wolf
lore:
Want to impress your friends?
Why not a Flying Wolf? Act now!

name: Hypnotist
lore:
Hypnotism works best against
those who don't expect it...

name: Mirage Goat
lore:
Warning: Mirage Goats in the 
area! Please check your mind
and sense of reality at the 
door. Thank you, the Management.

name: Mirage Nymph
lore:
Travellers who find themselves
witness to a Mirage Nymph
should take care to hydrate
themselves immediately.

name: Mirage Skeleton
lore:
Unlike regular mirages, Mirage
Skeletons are not illusions 
but rather symptoms of deep
metaphysical turmoil.

name: Mirage Trojan
lore:
Mirage Trojans are unusual
optical phenomena that only
appear when the temperature
and humidity fall within an
exact and dangerous range.

name: Monstrous Scorpion
lore:
It was said at that time that
the scarabs, and the cousins of
scarabs, grew fat and hungry in
the deathly darkness...

name: Mummified Servant
lore:
To be entrusted with the task
of serving the King after death?
Alastair could imagine no 
greater honor...

name: Necromancer
lore:
Necromancers draw their power
from the mysteries of death.

name: Roc Hatchling
lore:
It is said by some that a single
golden feather from the wing of
an infant roc can cure any ill
or ailment...

name: Snake Charmer
lore:
Nobody knew who he was or where
he came from. All that was 
known was that he carried an urn
containing sixteen snakes...

name: Swashbuckler
lore:
"I just got these new swords,"
remarked Bill. "We'd best be
attackin' somebody soon!"

name: Sword Swallower
lore:
His chest rippled with many
tattoos of a wild and foreign
script, and he had skill in 
the eating of swords...

name: Arnoldstein
lore:
Maybe scrawny isn't the way to
go. What about big arms? Like, 
HUGE arms? Yes!@
-Dr. F's Build Notes

name: Bayou Beast
lore:
Though fearsome and dangerous, 
the Bayou Beast always maintains
a cheery, upbeat disposition.

name: Bog Serpent
lore:
The Bog Serpent's spikes and 
viny scales help it quickly
gain purchase in the soft,
yielding terrain of its home.

name: Carrion Dog
lore:
The unusual coloration of the 
Carrion Dog is a consequence of
its unspeakable diet.

name: Connystein
lore:
I want my creature to be hugely
intelligent. Of course--two heads!
I'm a genius!@
-Dr. F's Build Notes

name: Disturbed Skeleton
lore:
Such are the evil energies of
the damned graveyard that the
very bones of the dead sometimes
rise to pester the living.

name: Fallen Huntress Hero
lore:
Arrows flew in feathered flocks
from her bow, but she too succumbed.

name: Fallen Swashbuckler Hero
lore:
His eye was sharp and his blade
mighty, but against the count's men
he could not prevail.

name: Fallen Warrior Hero
lore:
Though he fought valiantly with much
endurance, eventually he fell beneath
a hundred swords.

name: Fearful Farmer
lore:
"Around here superstition isn't
a sign of ignorance; it's a
necessary survival tactic."

name: Gargoyle
lore:
"In this maelstrom of evil, even
stone moves as though alive."@
-Van Helsing's Vampires

name: Ghoul Minion
lore:
"Is there an unhappier creature
on this earth than the Ghoul
Minion, foul and festering?"@
-Van Helsing's Vampires

name: Grave Robber
lore:
Despite their self-serving
justifications, grave robbers
are the bane of historians and
archaeologists.

name: Haggard Heckler
lore:
"People say they want to hear
honest, constructive criticism.
Then you tell them they're too
ugly and they get offended."

name: Hateful Housemaid
lore:
"Werewolves, vampires, spiders
from the sky... this broom has
a notch for just about every
kind of monster there is."

name: Highwayman
lore:
The highwayman came riding,
riding, riding, up to the
old inn door. He did some
walking, too.

name: Limping Leper
lore:
Contrary to popular belief,
leprosy is not incurable and can
be treated with a combination of
anti-bacterial drugs.

name: Malicious Magistrate
lore:
"The safety of our town depends
on diligence, preparation and firm
leadership. I'm Magistrate Sven,
and I approve this message."

name: Parkerstein
lore:
Lot of changes in this version.
New idea: Multiple limbs. Take a
look, see what you think.@
-Dr. F's Build Notes

name: Plagued Pork
lore:
Bacon tastes good,@
pork chops taste gooood.

name: Quag Hag
lore:
Until a live specimen was 
captured in 1715 from the fens
of Blovnia, most scholars doubted
the existence of the Quag Hag.

name: Tombstone Gargoyle
lore:
Though typically their job is
to adorn temples and churches,
some gargoyles get work on
simple tombs and gravestones.

name: Unliving Archer
lore:
"When I heard the call from beyond
the veil of death I knew it could 
mean only one thing: more archering!"

name: Unliving Brute
lore:
"In life my vocation was to 
deliver many crushing blows.
As an unliving brute I get to
play to those strengths."

name: Unliving Frostmancer
lore:
"For some reason I always see things
from the perspective of how cold they
are. It's a coherent worldview."

name: Unliving Pyromancer
lore:
"I thought I was finished when
those townsfolk set me on fire.
It's a good thing villains always
need undead servants."

name: Vampire Cultist
lore:
"What he was in life was forever
erased, all loyalties denied except
that to his dread master."@
-Van Helsing's Vampires

name: Vampire Mistress
lore:
"There was something about her
that made me uneasy."@
-Van Helsing's Vampires

name: Wandering Hag
lore:
They called me once, the
prophetess of lies, the
wandering hag, the pest of
every door...

name: Warrenstein
lore:
Still some bugs to work out
of the two-head system. This
build should fix most of them.@
-Dr. F's Build Notes

name: Wolf Pack
lore:
"What happens when werewolf
bites wolf? A were-were? A wolf-
wolf? A were-werewolf?"
